_comment: Display colour per Senate group code (official internal codes: UMP = LR, SOC = SER, CRC = CRCE-K, LREM = RDPI, RTLI = LIRT, AUCUN/NI = non-inscrits). Edit, then run from backend/: python -m importers display-settings --commit. Current groups: senat.fr hemicycle colours (Oct 2026), lightened for contrast on dark cards. Former groups: successor's colour or French Wikipedia party colours; CRARS, GDSRG and RP have none (the site uses a fallback).
